integrity: The rational identity is proved by bijective counting of completed greedy binary arches, constant remnants and central letters, using the independently cited existing palindrome center criterion. The standalone Python checker exhaustively compares all coefficient triples to length 20 and directly checks all scattered subsequences to length 12. Finite checks corroborate rather than prove the infinite identity. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
limitations: Binary labeled linear palindromes and fixed binary alphabet only. Counts scattered-subsequence universality indices, not complete Simon-congruence classes; no asserted extension to larger alphabets or necklaces. The half-word palindrome center rule is established prior work. An equivalent complete fixed-composition formula in differently indexed literature remains possible.
title: Fixed-composition subsequence-universality enumerator for binary palindromes
